limits: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage measures page renderer JS heap; it is not total Chrome process/worker/native/GPU memory. backingStorageSize is reported separately when available.

WebGL byte accounting counts explicit currently live buffer/texture/renderbuffer storage including mipmaps, without driver alignment, shader/program storage, implicit framebuffer or VRAM physical residency.
Instrumentation holds live resource handles until explicit delete; this is for deterministic allocation accounting and can inhibit automatic GC cleanup of forgotten resources.
Fixed-pose screenshots are internal actual 3D QA evidence, not user visual acceptance.
